origin: Target Racing emerged from the passionate vision of Alessandro Rossi, a wealthy Milanese industrialist with a lifelong love for motorsport. Disappointed with the lack of Italian representation in the higher echelons of GT racing, Rossi decided to create his own team, pouring a significant portion of his personal fortune into the venture. Initially, Target Racing focused on local Italian GT championships, quickly establishing themselves as a force to be reckoned with. A near-miss victory at the Vallelunga 6 Hours in their second year spurred Rossi to invest further, setting his sights on international competition.
philosophy: Target Racing operates on the principle of meticulous preparation and unwavering dedication. While embracing cutting-edge technology, the team emphasizes driver skill and mechanical sympathy above all else. Car development is a collaborative effort, with feedback from drivers playing a crucial role in refining the car's setup. The team culture fosters a sense of family, where every member is valued and encouraged to contribute their expertise.
achievements: Victory at the Mugello GT Challenge (2021)
Pole position at the Imola GT Sprint (2022)
Podium finish at the Paul Ricard GT Endurance (2023)
Multiple top-five finishes in the GT World Challenge Europe

teamPrincipal.name: Marco Bellini
teamPrincipal.background: Bellini is a seasoned motorsport veteran with decades of experience managing various racing teams, including a stint in Formula 3. His calm demeanor and strategic mind have been instrumental in Target Racing's success.

keyFigures.name: Sofia Lombardi
keyFigures.description: Lombardi is a brilliant engineer renowned for her innovative solutions and meticulous attention to detail. She oversees all aspects of car development and trackside engineering.

headquarters: Target Racing is based in a modest workshop near Monza, Italy. While their facilities are not state-of-the-art, they are well-equipped and maintained, reflecting the team's commitment to professionalism.
fanBase: Target Racing enjoys a loyal following among Italian motorsport enthusiasts, who appreciate the team's commitment to local talent and their relentless pursuit of excellence. The team's underdog spirit resonates with fans who admire their ability to compete against larger, more established teams.
